Why "Rewired"?

It's not bad luck. It's a pattern.

If you keep attracting the same person, it's not bad luck. It's a pattern. And patterns live in your nervous system, in your inner child, and in the beliefs you picked up long before you ever met him.

You can attract anyone. Who you choose is what matters. And who you choose comes from how safe your body feels with love.

Love, Rewired works on three layers:

Layer one
Your nervous system
Learning to regulate your triggers, so anxiety stops drowning out your intuition.
Layer two
Your inner child
Using my Divine Reparenting Method™ to meet your protector parts and give your inner child the love she's been waiting for.
Layer three
Your choices
Communicating, setting boundaries, receiving love, and choosing partners who choose you back.
IX · The Hermit

This is the Hermit's work: taking a lantern into your inner world, one room at a time. Every breakthrough in these three months is another room you can finally see clearly.

How I work with you

I'm your lighthouse. You're the captain.

I can't sail your ship for you, and I won't try. You are always responsible for your own life.

But I can shine the light while you navigate the storm. I've been through it myself: the dark night of the soul, the painful rejection, the long separation, the years of runners. I came out the other side by committing to myself and getting real support.

Now I'm married to a man who chooses me, again and again.

For three months, you won't be doing this alone.
